The role involves creating high-quality visual content for digital and print platforms while ensuring consistency with Rixos Hotels' brand identity, corporate standards, and marketing objectives.
Graphic design and visual content development.
Digital and print marketing materials production.
Brand consistency and corporate identity compliance.
Marketing Department operational standards, policies, and procedures adherence.

d: Mace combines construction expertise with consultancy to unlock potential in every person or project and redefine the boundaries of ambition. Our values shape the way we consult and define the people we want to join us on our journey.

This project offers the chance to join a talented Mace team in delivering a major entertainment and luxury hospitality project, collaborating with renowned architects and global consultants. The project involves extensive infrastructure and built assets, delivered rapidly through a hands-on construction management approach, ideal for those experienced in managing both main and subcontract packages.
We are seeking an experienced logistics manager to manage and coordinate day-to-day construction logistics activities across a large and complex construction project.

The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring the safe and efficient movement of people, vehicles, materials, and plant, while coordinating with multiple contractors and project stakeholders.
This is a hands-on operational role requiring strong construction logistics experience, forward planning, and the ability to manage competing demands across an active construction environment.
r: Manage and coordinate daily construction logistics activities across the project.
Implement and maintain the construction logistics plan and associated logistics procedures.
Coordinate logistics requirements across multiple contractors and work packages.
Manage vehicle, material, plant, and personnel movements across construction areas.
Coordinate haul roads, access routes, delivery routes, laydown areas, loading and unloading zones, holding areas, and logistics compounds.
Plan upcoming logistics requirements with construction teams and contractors.
Manage delivery schedules and minimise conflicts between contractors competing for shared access and resources.
Review contractor logistics plans, traffic management arrangements, mobilisation plans, and proposed site layouts.
Coordinate road closures, diversions, and temporary traffic management requirements.
Monitor site access, vehicle movements, and delivery arrangements to ensure agreed controls are followed.
Identify logistics constraints and work with contractors and project teams to implement practical solutions.
Attend and contribute to construction and logistics coordination meetings.
Maintain close coordination with construction, health and safety, security, engineering, and other project functions.
Monitor contractor compliance with project logistics requirements and raise issues where necessary.
Support mobilisation and demobilisation of contractors and construction areas.
Provide clear logistics updates, reports, and briefings to senior management.
Ensure logistics operations are delivered in accordance with project health, safety, and environmental requirements.
Promote continuous improvement in logistics safety, planning, and operational efficiency.
Degree, diploma, or recognised qualification in logistics, construction management, engineering, or a related discipline.
Relevant construction health and safety qualification.
Membership of a recognised logistics, construction, or project management professional body would be advantageous.
Relevant experience in construction logistics, site logistics, or a closely related construction environment.
Strong experience working on major construction, infrastructure, or large-scale development projects.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
Experience with construction logistics, delivery management, or planning systems would be advantageous.
AutoCAD experience is desirable but not essential.
Demonstrable experience coordinating multiple contractors within an active construction environment.
Practical knowledge of construction site logistics, traffic management, access control, and delivery management.
Experience coordinating high volumes of vehicles, materials, and plants.
Experience implementing construction logistics plans and site logistics procedures.
Good understanding of haul roads, laydown areas, delivery routes, vehicle holding areas, and construction access requirements.
Experience identifying and resolving logistics conflicts and constraints.
Strong contractor and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to plan ahead and coordinate activities around changing construction priorities.
Strong communication, reporting and organisational skills.
Ability to work independently and take ownership of logistics issues through to resolution.
